Sandbox_VehicleLivingSlots_FridgePowerCo: Displayed at 1000 times the fridge's actual auxiliary-battery drain per game minute. Default: 0.04, giving about 17.36 game days on a full battery. Set to 0 to stop drain; an installed auxiliary battery is still required.
Sandbox_VehicleLivingSlots_MicrowavePowe: Displayed at 1000 times the microwave's actual auxiliary-battery drain per active game minute. Default: 0.4, ten times the fridge rate. Set to 0 to stop drain; an installed auxiliary battery is still required.
Sandbox_VehicleLivingSlots_WaterPurifica: Displayed at 1000 times the auxiliary-battery drain per litre of water purified. Default: 0.4, matching the microwave rate. Set to 0 to stop drain; an installed auxiliary battery is still required.
Sandbox_VehicleLivingSlots_TelevisionPow: Displayed at 1000 times the television's actual auxiliary-battery drain per active game minute. Default: 0.4, matching the microwave rate. Set to 0 to stop drain; an installed auxiliary battery is still required.
